# CRM Industry Adoption & Implementation Considerations

| Consideration | Industry-level guidance |
| --- | --- |
| Workflow priority | Export manufacturing, industrial distribution and cross-border B2B commonly share lead, RFQ, quotation, order and collection dependencies. |
| Evaluation metrics | Compare manual-entry time, follow-up coverage, first-quote time, quotation error rate and forecast preparation time against a defined baseline. |
| Data readiness | Reconcile account, contact, product, price, opportunity, order and collection masters before automation. |
| Integration model | Use staged connector rollout, field mapping, reconciliation and clear ownership between sales, finance and operations. |
| Regional operation | Apply country-specific privacy, marketing, language, time-zone, currency and data-residency rules rather than one universal policy. |
| Evidence quality | Separate audited outcomes, research estimates, supplier claims and internal measurements; do not generalise one customer result. |
